name: Agent
description: 3–8 players. Everyone shares a secret location + a role at that location, EXCEPT one player who is the Spy and knows neither. Players take turns asking each other questions; non-spies probe without revealing the location, the Spy bluffs to blend in. Spy wins by correctly guessing the location OR if the table fails to vote them out. Townfolk win by majority-voting out the Spy.

phases.name: playing
phases.description: Single phase. Spyfall module cycles question → answer → optional accusation → vote / spy guess internally.

entity_types.name: Player
entity_types.description: A player at the secret location — or the Spy who doesn't know where they are.

actions.name: ask
actions.description: ASKER ONLY (question stage). REQUIRED `target`: entity_id of the player you're questioning. REQUIRED `question`: short, pointed, location-specific. Good questions probe ROLE knowledge without naming the place. EXAMPLE: ask(target="p_002", question="What's the first thing you do when you arrive at work?").

actions.name: answer
actions.description: TARGET ONLY (right after being asked). REQUIRED `text`: your answer. If non-spy: sound credible without naming the place. If spy: bluff plausibly. EXAMPLE: answer(text="I check the schedule and grab my uniform.").

actions.name: accuse
actions.description: ANY PLAYER (question stage). REQUIRED `target`: entity_id of the player you accuse of being the Spy. Triggers an immediate sealed vote on whether they are the Spy. EXAMPLE: accuse(target="p_003").

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Player you accuse of being the Spy.

actions.name: guess_location
actions.description: SPY ONLY. REQUIRED `location`: your guess at the secret location (case-insensitive, partial match accepted). Correct = Spy wins instantly; wrong = Townfolk win. EXAMPLE: guess_location(location="Casino").

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Your guess at the secret location.

actions.name: vote_spy
actions.description: ALL PLAYERS (vote stage). REQUIRED `target`: entity_id of the player you think is the Spy. Sealed; reveals together. EXAMPLE: vote_spy(target="p_001").

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Player entity_id you accuse of being the Spy.

actions.name: discuss
actions.description: Open speech for players who aren't actively asking/answering. Argue your read, defend yourself, point fingers without formally accusing.

personas.persona_text: Careful and observant. You ask the kind of questions that look innocent but yield a tell.
goals: Identify the Spy from their answers.

personas.persona_text: Brash and confident. You go for confrontational reads; bad guesses don't faze you.
goals: Make the table commit to a read.

personas.persona_text: Quiet analyst. You wait until the answers contradict before you push.
Friendly chatterbox. You disarm with humor and watch reactions, not words.
goals: Get the Spy to reveal themselves emotionally.

personas.persona_text: Strategic. You ask questions that ONLY someone with the role would answer confidently.
goals: Surface a hesitation in the Spy's answer.

personas.persona_text: Intuitive. You read tone and timing; you call accusations from the gut.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.spyfall.max_questions
runtime_parameters.label: Question Rounds
runtime_parameters.description: How many questions before a forced final vote. Accusations are locked until EVERY player has answered at least once, so each round-robin probes the whole table.

termination_conditions.name: spy_wins
termination_conditions.description: Spy guesses location OR survives wrong vote.
